headline: Should Healthpeak’s Raised 2026 EPS Guidance and Profitability Shift Require Action From Healthpeak Properties (DOC) Investors?
summary: In August 2026, Healthpeak Properties, Inc. reported second-quarter 2026 results showing revenue of US$771.58 million and net income of US$52.82 million, alongside higher earnings per share from continuing operations compared with a year earlier. For the first half of 2026, the company’s net income rose to US$246.45 million and it raised full-year diluted EPS guidance to US$0.48–US$0.52, pointing to improved profitability expectations.
